title: Adding Insights View for Functional Tests in Playwright
description: Verify that the Insights view correctly displays functional test results and integrates with existing test types
testDescription: This test ensures that functional test results appear in the Insights view alongside other test types (Unit, Integration, API) with proper visualization components
prerequisites:
1. Playwright test environment is set up and accessible
2. Existing Insights view for Unit, Integration, and API tests is functional
3. Sample functional test results are available for testing
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the test insights dashboard
2. Verify that a 'Functional Tests' section or filter exists in the UI
3. Click on the Functional Tests section/filter
4. Examine the visualization components for functional tests
5. Compare the structure to existing test type displays
expectedResult:
1. The Insights dashboard includes a clearly visible 'Functional Tests' section
2. Functional test results are displayed with appropriate visualizations (charts, graphs, tables)
3. The structure and presentation is consistent with existing test types
4. All UI components render correctly without visual defects
dataRequirements: Sample set of passed, failed, and skipped functional tests

title: Data Integration Between Functional Test Results and Insights View
description: Verify that functional test result data is accurately reflected in the Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that all data from functional test executions is correctly captured, processed, and displayed in the Insights view with no discrepancies
prerequisites:
1. Multiple functional tests have been executed with a mix of results
2. The Insights view has been implemented for functional tests
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a set of functional tests with known outcomes
2. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
3. View the functional test results section
4. Compare the displayed results with the actual test execution results
5. Verify test counts, pass/fail ratios, and other metrics
6. Check for data accuracy in charts and graphs
expectedResult:
1. All functional test results are accurately represented in the Insights view
2. Test counts match the executed tests
3. Pass/fail ratios are calculated correctly
4. Metrics and KPIs are accurate
5. No discrepancies exist between actual test results and displayed data
dataValidationChecks: Result counts, execution times, pass percentages, failure rates, flaky test identification

title: Filtering and Sorting of Functional Test Results in Insights View
description: Verify that users can filter and sort functional test results in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that all filtering and sorting options work correctly for functional test results, allowing users to find specific information quickly
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Multiple functional tests with various statuses, durations, and tags exist
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the functional tests view
3. Test each available filter option (status, duration, test name, etc.)
4. Apply multiple filters simultaneously
5. Test each sorting option (alphabetical, duration, execution time)
6. Verify that filter and sort can be combined
7. Clear all filters and sorting
expectedResult:
1. Each filter correctly narrows down the displayed test results
2. Multiple filters work in combination
3. Sorting changes the order of displayed results appropriately
4. Filters and sorting can be combined successfully
5. Clearing filters resets the view to show all results
6. The UI properly indicates active filters and sort orders
filterOptions: Status (Pass/Fail/Skip), Duration (Fast/Slow), Test Name, Test Suite, Test Category, Execution Date
sortingOptions: Alphabetical, Duration (Ascending/Descending), Execution Date, Pass Rate

title: Cross-Test Type Comparison in Insights View
description: Verify that users can compare functional test results with other test types in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides a unified perspective across all test types, allowing comparison between functional tests and other existing test types
prerequisites:
1. Insights view implementation for all test types (Unit, Integration, API, Functional)
2. Test results available for all test types
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Navigate to a view that displays all test types together
3. Check if there are comparison charts/graphs available
4. Use filters to compare specific metrics across test types
5. Test any specific comparison features (overlays, side-by-side views)
6. Verify that toggling between test types maintains context/filters where appropriate
expectedResult:
1. The Insights view provides a unified perspective across all test types
2. Comparison visualizations correctly represent data from different test types
3. Functional tests can be directly compared with other test types
4. Toggling between test types works smoothly
5. Consistent metrics are used across all test types for fair comparison
comparisonMetrics: Pass rate, Duration, Flakiness, Coverage, Execution frequency, Failure trends
visualComponents: Comparison charts, Cross-type dashboards, Unified metrics view, Trend comparisons

title: Performance of Insights View with Large Functional Test Datasets
description: Verify that the Insights view performs adequately with large volumes of functional test results
testDescription: This test evaluates the performance, responsiveness, and stability of the Insights view when handling a large number of functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Test environment capable of generating large volumes of test results
2. Insights view implementation for functional tests
3. Performance measurement tools configured
stepsToPerform:
1. Generate or import a large dataset of functional test results (1000+ tests)
2. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
3. Measure initial load time for the functional tests view
4. Interact with various UI elements (filters, sorts, charts)
5. Measure response times for each interaction
6. Apply complex filtering and sorting operations
7. Test pagination or infinite scrolling if applicable
8. Monitor browser memory consumption throughout testing
expectedResult:
1. Initial page load completes within acceptable time (<3 seconds)
2. UI remains responsive when interacting with large datasets
3. Charts and visualizations render correctly with large data volumes
4. No UI freezing or browser crashes occur
5. Memory usage remains within acceptable limits
6. Data accuracy is maintained with large datasets
performanceMetrics: Page load time, Interaction response time, Memory usage, CPU utilization, Network requests
datasetSize: Small (100 tests), Medium (500 tests), Large (1000+ tests), Very Large (5000+ tests)

title: Real-time Data Update for Functional Test Results in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view automatically updates when new functional test results become available
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights dashboard reflects new functional test results in real-time or through a manual refresh mechanism without requiring full page reloads
prerequisites:
1. Playwright test environment is set up
2. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
3. Ability to trigger new test runs while observing the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Note the current functional test results displayed
3. In a separate tab or window, trigger execution of new functional tests
4. Return to the Insights dashboard
5. Wait for automatic refresh or click any manual refresh option
6. Observe if new test results appear without page reload
7. Check timestamps to verify data freshness
expectedResult:
1. New functional test results appear in the Insights view after tests complete
2. Data refresh occurs without full page reload (either automatically or via refresh button)
3. Timestamps update to reflect the latest data
4. All visualizations correctly incorporate the new data points
5. Any calculated metrics (pass rate, etc.) update accordingly
refreshMechanisms: Automatic refresh, Manual refresh button, Polling interval
dataVerification: Result count before/after, Timestamp checks, Visual indication of updated data

title: Error State Handling in Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view properly handles and displays error states when accessing functional test data
testDescription: This test validates that appropriate error messages and fallback UI states are presented when there are issues with functional test data retrieval or processing
prerequisites:
1. Playwright test environment is set up
2. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
3. Ability to simulate various error conditions
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Simulate network connection failure during data fetch
3. Observe error handling and messaging
4. Simulate scenario with no functional test data available
5. Observe empty state handling
6. Simulate partial data corruption or missing fields
7. Simulate server returning error responses (5xx, 4xx)
8. Test retry mechanisms if available
expectedResult:
1. Appropriate error messages are displayed for different error conditions
2. No blank screens or unhandled exceptions occur
3. Empty states show helpful guidance rather than just 'No data'
4. Partial data loads show what's available while indicating missing components
5. Retry options are provided where appropriate
6. Error states maintain UI consistency and don't break layout
errorConditions: Network failure, Empty dataset, Malformed data, Server errors, Authentication issues
uiRequirements: Error messaging, Empty state designs, Partial data indicators, Retry buttons

title: Accessibility Compliance of Functional Test Insights Visualization Components
description: Verify that all visualization components in the functional test Insights view meet accessibility standards
testDescription: This test ensures that charts, graphs, tables and other visualization components used for functional test results comply with WCAG accessibility guidelines
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Accessibility testing tools configured (axe, Lighthouse, etc.)
3. Screen reader software available for testing
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard for functional tests
2. Run automated accessibility checks using axe or similar tools
3. Verify color contrast of all visualization elements
4. Test keyboard navigation through all interactive components
5. Verify presence of alternative text for charts and graphs
6. Test with screen reader to ensure data is properly announced
7. Check that interactive elements have appropriate ARIA attributes
8. Verify text scaling doesn't break visualizations
expectedResult:
1. No critical accessibility violations are found by automated tools
2. All visualization components meet color contrast requirements (4.5:1 minimum)
3. All interactive elements are keyboard accessible with visible focus indicators
4. Screen readers can access and announce chart data and insights
5. All data visualizations have appropriate text alternatives
6. Interactive components have proper ARIA roles and states

title: Export and Sharing Functionality for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that users can export and share functional test insights data in various formats
testDescription: This test validates the ability to export functional test results data from the Insights view in various formats and share insights with stakeholders
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Export functionality is implemented
3. Test results data is available in the system
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard for functional tests
2. Locate export/share options in the UI
3. Test exporting data in each available format (CSV, PDF, etc.)
4. Verify exports with filtered/sorted data preserve those selections
5. Test any direct sharing options (email, link sharing)
6. For each export, verify the data integrity and completeness
7. Test export of specific charts or visualizations if supported
expectedResult:
1. Export options are clearly visible and accessible
2. All supported export formats generate valid files
3. Exported data accurately reflects what's displayed in the UI
4. Filters and sorting are preserved in exported data
5. Exported visualizations maintain visual fidelity
6. Shared links correctly preserve view state
7. Large data sets export completely without truncation
sharingOptions: Direct link, Email, Scheduled reports, Dashboard embedding

title: Custom Dashboard Creation for Functional Test Results
description: Verify that users can create custom dashboards focusing on specific functional test metrics and KPIs
testDescription: This test ensures that users can create, save, and access custom dashboards with personalized views of functional test results and metrics
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Custom dashboard functionality is available
3. User has appropriate permissions to create dashboards
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Access the custom dashboard creation interface
3. Add various widgets specific to functional test results
4. Configure each widget with specific metrics, filters, and display options
5. Save the custom dashboard with a unique name
6. Exit and re-access the custom dashboard
7. Modify the existing dashboard by adding/removing widgets
8. Test sharing the custom dashboard with other users if supported
expectedResult:
1. Custom dashboard interface allows selection of functional test-specific widgets
2. Widgets can be configured with various metrics and visualization types
3. Dashboard layout can be customized (resizing, repositioning widgets)
4. Saved dashboards persist between sessions
5. Dashboards accurately display selected metrics and maintain configurations
6. Shared dashboards are accessible to other users with correct permissions
availableWidgets: Pass/fail trends, Test duration distribution, Flaky test identification, Failure categories, Test coverage metrics
customizationOptions: Widget size, Layout grid, Color schemes, Refresh intervals, Data thresholds

title: Automated Tagging and Categorization of Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Verify that functional tests can be automatically tagged and categorized in the Insights view for improved organization and analysis
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view can automatically tag and categorize functional tests based on predefined rules, test content, or execution patterns
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Tagging/categorization system is configured
3. Multiple functional tests with varying characteristics exist in the system
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Access the configuration section for functional test categorization
3. Create or verify existence of auto-tagging rules (e.g., by test duration, feature area, or result pattern)
4. Execute a set of functional tests that should trigger different categorization rules
5. Navigate to the Insights view for functional tests
6. Verify the tests are appropriately tagged and categorized
7. Filter results by specific tags/categories
8. Modify an existing tag rule and verify it updates affected tests
expectedResult:
1. Functional tests are automatically tagged based on configured rules
2. Tests appear in appropriate categories in the Insights view
3. Tag/category filters correctly display only relevant tests
4. Tag rule modifications are applied to both new and existing test results
5. Tag statistics and distribution are accurately displayed in summary views
tagTypes: Performance-related, UI components, API interactions, Data validation, Feature area
categoryRules: By duration (fast/slow), By feature area, By failure frequency, By test complexity

title: Historical Trend Analysis for Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view provides historical trend analysis for functional test results over time
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view can display historical trends of functional test executions, allowing teams to identify patterns and improvements over time
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Historical data for functional test executions is available
3. Date/time filtering capabilities are implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Access the functional tests section
3. Locate the historical trends visualization components
4. Test different time range selections (last week, month, quarter, custom range)
5. Verify trend data for key metrics (pass rate, duration, flaky tests)
6. Compare trends across different test suites or categories
7. Export trend data for offline analysis if supported
expectedResult:
1. Historical trend visualizations (line charts, bar graphs) display correctly
2. Time range selectors modify the displayed data appropriately
3. Trend lines accurately reflect the actual test execution history
4. Important events or changes are marked on the timeline if configured
5. Hover/tooltip information provides detailed metrics for specific time points
6. Comparative trend analysis shows meaningful differences between test categories
trendMetrics: Pass rate over time, Average execution time, Flaky test occurrences, Total test count growth, Failure categories distribution
timeRangeOptions: Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last quarter, Custom date range, Week-over-week, Month-over-month

title: Notification and Alerting System for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that users can configure and receive notifications based on functional test results in the Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that the notification system can alert users about important functional test result patterns, failures, or other configurable conditions
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Notification system is configured
3. User has appropriate permissions to set up alerts
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Access the notification configuration section
3. Create alerts for various conditions (e.g., pass rate drops below threshold, specific tests fail, execution time exceeds limit)
4. Configure delivery methods (in-app, email, integration with communication tools)
5. Trigger conditions that should activate notifications
6. Verify notifications are delivered through configured channels
7. Modify and disable notifications to test configuration changes
expectedResult:
1. Alert configuration interface is accessible and user-friendly
2. Alerts are triggered accurately when conditions are met
3. Notifications are delivered through all configured channels
4. Notification content includes relevant information about the triggering condition
5. Alert history is maintained and viewable
6. Modifying alert conditions correctly updates the triggering behavior
alertConditions: Pass rate threshold, Specific test failures, Execution time thresholds, Consecutive failures, Test coverage changes, New flaky tests detected
deliveryChannels: Email, In-app notifications, Slack/Teams integration, SMS (if configured), Webhook integration

title: Root Cause Analysis Tools for Failed Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view provides tools to help identify root causes of failed functional tests
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view includes features to help analyze and determine the root causes of functional test failures
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Root cause analysis features are available
3. Failed functional tests exist in the system
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Access the section for failed functional tests
3. Select a specific failed test to analyze
4. Examine available diagnostic information (screenshots, logs, network activity, console errors)
5. Test correlation features that link similar failures
6. Use any pattern recognition tools to identify common failure modes
7. Check if the system suggests possible root causes based on analysis
8. Verify links to relevant code repositories or changes if available
expectedResult:
1. Detailed failure information is accessible for each failed test
2. Screenshots or videos of failure points are available and properly displayed
3. Console logs and network activity around failure points are captured
4. Similar failures are correctly grouped or linked
5. Pattern analysis tools identify meaningful correlations between failures
6. Root cause suggestions, if available, are relevant and helpful
7. Historical failure data for the same test is accessible for comparison
diagnosticInformation: Screenshots, Video recordings, Console logs, Network requests, DOM state, Environment variables, Test steps timeline
analysisTools: Failure clustering, Pattern recognition, Timeline correlation, Environmental factor analysis, Code change correlation

title: Test Environment Impact Analysis on Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view can correlate functional test results with different test environments and configurations
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view can help identify how different test environments and configurations affect functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Insights view for functional tests is implemented
2. Tests are executed across multiple environments/configurations
3. Environment metadata is captured with test results
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Access the environment analysis section for functional tests
3. View comparison of test results across different environments (dev, staging, production)
4. Filter results by specific environment factors (OS, browser version, screen size, etc.)
5. Identify tests with environment-dependent failures
6. Check for environment performance comparison visualizations
7. Generate reports showing environment impact on specific test suites
expectedResult:
1. Test results are correctly segmented by environment
2. Environment-specific failures are highlighted or flagged
3. Performance differences across environments are visualized
4. Filtering by environment properties works correctly
5. Environment comparison views show meaningful differences
6. Reports accurately represent the impact of environment on test results
7. Environment configuration details are accessible when analyzing specific failures
environmentFactors: Operating system, Browser type and version, Screen resolution, Network conditions, Server configurations, Database versions, Feature flags
comparisonViews: Side-by-side results, Pass rate by environment, Performance variations, Environment-specific failures, Configuration drift detection
